vb_textbox.text: I initially tried to figure out which colours yielded higher points. This was effective in the training round and initially in the main game. I noticed for example, that brown yielded a low result and light purple a high result.After a few rounds, this became ineffectual and I found greatest success concentrating on which side yielded the best results. I stuck with the side that gained the most mushrooms, and when the level went down, I switched to the opposite side.
